tagline: Plucked-string koto synth using a delay-line string model
description: An 8-voice plucked-string instrument: a noise burst excites a tuned delay-line (comb filter) string, which then passes through a tone low-pass and three body-resonance peaks. The string loop has no damping filter, so all harmonics decay at the same rate. The Scale parameter (In-sen, Hirajoshi, Iwato, Kumoi, Chromatic) is stored but does not yet change the sound.

features.name: Delay-Line String
features.description: A comb filter tuned to the note, with loop feedback from 0.994 to 0.9995 set by Decay (0.1-2).

features.name: Play Style
features.description: Pluck excites the string once, Tremolo re-plucks at the Tremolo Rate (2-20 Hz) and Scrape feeds noise in continuously while the key is held.

features.name: Body Resonance
features.description: Blends in up to 60% of three peaking filters at 250 Hz, 800 Hz and 2 kHz.

features.name: Tone, Attack and Pitch Bend
features.description: A one-pole low-pass for brightness, a 1-100 ms fade-in, and a fixed pitch offset of up to 2 semitones (a parameter, not the MIDI pitch wheel).
